transcript.text: microwve plate wont go round anymore, food hot on one side cold on other. still heats tho

The most common cause is simply that the glass tray has come off its drive coupler or something is catching it, but if it's seated correctly, the plastic coupler in the middle may have cracked or the motor itself could have failed.
[Safety panel] Don't remove the microwave's casing or try to repair it inside. Parts inside a microwave can hold a dangerous electric charge even after it's unplugged — have it checked by a qualified engineer.
the plate sits on the middle bit but wobbles. i dropped it in the sink last week and put it back on a bit roughly. what should i check?

The wobble is a clear sign that something isn't gripping properly. Since you dropped it roughly, the most likely culprit is the small plastic drive coupler in the middle of the microwave floor—it often cracks or snaps when the tray is slammed down. Please unplug the microwave first for safety, then lift out the glass plate and check if that central plastic piece is cracked or has broken prongs. If it looks intact, we'll need to look at the roller ring underneath.
[Safety panel] Don't remove the microwave's casing or try to repair it inside. Parts inside a microwave can hold a dangerous electric charge even after it's unplugged — have it checked by a qualified engineer.
ok unplugged it and took the plate out. the little 3 pronged plastic piece in the middle has a crack in it and the hole in the middle looks rounded. it wobbles and doesnt really turn

[Heading: Likely cause: turntable coupler]
That cracked plastic piece is most likely the problem. Because it has broken, the motor can't grip the glass plate properly to turn it, which leaves food cold spots even though the magnetron is still working fine. To get you the correct replacement part, I need your microwave's make and model number (usually found on a label inside the door frame or on the back). Once we have that, I can tell you exactly what to buy.

its a Sharp R272WM, found it on the label on the back

The cracked plastic piece is most likely the cause of the wobble and lack of rotation.
